\title[Statins and Delirium]{Statin Use and Postoperative Delirium in Older Adults: a Cohort Study}

\author*[1,2]{\fnm{Hanna} \spfx{van der} \sur{Berg}}\email{h.vanderberg@umcg.nl}

\abstract{\textbf{Purpose:} To estimate whether statin use before surgery lowers the risk of delirium.

\textbf{Methods:} A retrospective cohort of 4\,812 patients aged 70 or older.

\textbf{Results:} Delirium occurred in 9.1\% of statin users and 12.4\% of non-users.

\textbf{Conclusion:} Statin use was associated with less postoperative delirium.}

\keywords{delirium, statins, geriatric surgery, cohort study}

\pacs[MSC Classification]{92C50}

\maketitle

\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}

Delirium is common after surgery \cite{knuth}. Earlier work \cite{lamport} suggests a link.
